title: CLEARONE INC 8-K Filing — 2026-04-23
summary: ClearOne, Inc. filed a Form 8-K announcing the completion of its reincorporation from Delaware to Nevada, effective April 22, 2026 at 4:00 p.m. Eastern Time. The company's common stock continues to trade on The Nasdaq Capital Market under symbol CLRO. The reincorporation did not result in any change to the company's business, assets, liabilities, or operations.

New Nevada Articles authorize 200,000,000 shares of capital stock (150M common, 50M preferred)
No change to company's business, assets, liabilities, or operations as a result of reincorporation
Stockholder rights now governed by Nevada law instead of Delaware law
